doc: Labelled accuracy set for the keyword business-fit decision (KW-ACC, 2026-10-21): should this website target this search at all? One case per (site, keyword). `label` is in (a page of this site may target it) or out (no page should), `expect` is the reason class a careful human gives, `reason` one line in plain words, `source` the evidence (a file of the 2026-10-21 paid run, a live page, a site fixture, or human judgement on the declared services). `serp` (optional) is the keyword's real results page from that run (top domains in rank order, people-also-ask), passed to the gate on the path that reads a results page. Labels are independent of what the code decides today: score_keywords.js runs the real generated gate and the full report's Analyze Keywords node, and scenario KWACC ratchets on KEYWORDS_BASELINE.md. How the set is labelled and scored: KEYWORDS_BASELINE.md (its first sections).

classes.other_brand: names another company or its product
classes.navigational: a sign-in or own-site task: people want one particular website
classes.government: a public body, its portal or its service to a person
classes.career: people looking for work, pay or training
classes.too_broad: only category words: says nothing about this website
classes.in_topic: a search a page of this website may target
